scenario_description:
Objective: Complete the hallway fan-coil filter swap and restore the return grille before the late-morning scan work that needs quiet airflow.
Emerging Need: The swap begins, then the old filter wedges half-out after a retaining clip cracks, leaving the grille open and the unit unable to resume.
Decision Context: Stored fan-coil guidance distinguishes this from a safe owner reset and ties any same-day recovery to the building's posted maintenance desk and board cutoff.
Consequence: Once the add-on board closes, the filter remains trapped and the air handler stays paused until a later routine opening.

parameter.title: Hallway fan-coil filter swap before scan block
parameter.description: Replace the hallway return filter and close the grille before the map scan setup starts.

parameter.content: Maintenance mode opened at 09:05. Hallway return grille is open and the fan is paused for filter access.
I started the hallway fan-coil filter swap, but the upper clip snapped while the old filter was halfway out. The grille is hanging open and the new filter will not slide in; I stopped before prying.

parameter.name: Loring House Maintenance Desk - Sept 13
parameter.notes: Posted rostered desk for Sunday routine in-unit add-ons; include unit number and fixture location when submitting small fan-coil or cabinet tasks.

parameter.subject: Sunday small-task board closes at 10:45
parameter.body: The routine in-unit maintenance board still has a few Sunday add-on slots. Items received by 10:45 can be routed today if they are within building small-task scope and include the posted desk contact.

parameter.subject: Sunday small-task board is closed
parameter.body: The same-day routine in-unit board closed at 10:45. New non-emergency fan-coil and grille items will be placed on the next routine opening, currently Tuesday morning.
